description: Implementation of the DigitalProductService interface, providing methods to add, retrieve, delete, and save or update digital products associated with products in the catalog. It interacts with DAOs, file management, and product services to manage digital product files within the system.

classes.name: DigitalProductServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for managing digital products, providing operations like add, delete, retrieve, and save/update digital product entities, integrated with persistence and file management.

methods.name: addProductFile
methods.description: Adds a digital file to a product, saves the digital product, and manages the physical file via file manager. Sets the product as virtual.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a DigitalProduct entity associated with a specific store and product.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a digital product, removes associated file, and updates product status.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing DigitalProduct, ensuring the associated product is marked as virtual.
